SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM api_test_cases tc WHERE tc.collection_id = c.id) AS case_count, r.id AS last_run_id, r.created_at AS last_run_at, CASE WHEN r.total > 0 THEN ROUND(r.passed * 100 / r.total) ELSE NULL END AS pass_rate FROM api_test_collections c LEFT JOIN api_test_runs r ON r.id = (SELECT r2.id FROM api_test_runs r2 WHERE r2.collection_id = c.id ORDER BY r2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.name
SELECT * FROM api_test_collections WHERE project = #{project} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_test_collections (id, project, name, description, enabled, sort_order, scope, lifecycle, requirement_no, app_version, source_branch, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{project}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{scope}, #{lifecycle}, #{requirementNo}, #{appVersion}, #{sourceBranch}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_test_collections SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, scope = #{scope}, lifecycle = #{lifecycle}, requirement_no = #{requirementNo}, app_version = #{appVersion}, source_branch = #{sourceBranch}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE api_test_collections SET lifecycle = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE api_test_collections SET lifecycle = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE requirement_no = #{requirementNo} AND scope = 'TEST'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM api_test_cases WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC
